In the failure snapshot the page is fully rendered with the skip link present but nothing focused. Root cause from the spec and app: after page.reload() the test waits only for html[lang], which public/locale-boot.js sets before first paint, then presses Tab before the shell has mounted. Product behaviour is correct whenever the shell is mounted. Test-synchronisation defect -> F-DG1-232 (Low, non-mandatory).

summary: FAIL on one Low, non-mandatory finding only. Both round-1 qa findings (F-DG1-230, F-DG1-231) are fixed and CLOSED_VERIFIED. All 12 requirements are verified on candidate e6979e12 with existing evidence, and every other required check passed: static checks, unit tests 326/326 on Node 22 and 24, integration 209/209 twice with 9 migrations and no 57P01 or hook timeout, A12/A13/A14, A18, A20, contract tests including getBrandingTokens, the DB guard and the concurrent API race, and the validators. The one failure: the first run of the required journey e2e failed one EN test (skip-link focus asserted before the shell mounted after reload). The spec is serial, so 7 more EN journeys were skipped. It reproduced 1 time in 15 under load. F-DG1-232 is a test-synchronisation defect, not a product defect. Because a required gate check is non-deterministic and that run is recorded as FAIL, the verdict cannot be PASS. D-057 and D-058 cover the live-registry and live-CI effects, which were not claimed.
